author: 0mib
body:
They are hard to find, I'm stuck on this one myself. I live in a rural area with lots of trees but no areas thick enough to be marked as 'Forest' on the map. I drive up to my buddy's house in the mountains where it's all forest and farm like 10 of them in a couple hours. Looking for an excuse to go back, but that's my experience, you need to find an area marked as Forest on the map. I've heard they spawn in certain dungeons but that has never been my experience. The only other option is to roam around looking for area bosses but I've only found four of them that way.

EDIT:  I think I also found a couple using a chaos scroll, I believe it's designed to summon monsters regardless of biome/weather restrictions, could be wrong though. And you end up with a lot of tough guys to wade through.
